_comment: Default inference configuration for the YOLOv11 wind comfort segmentation pipeline.
_comment_force_best_guess: Fills background/uncovered pixels with the nearest predicted class via distance transform. Prevents large unassigned holes in the output map.
_comment_imgsz: Must match the imgsz used during training (currently 1280). Changing this will cause a receptive-field mismatch and degrade accuracy.
